rows.en: Ymir: "What does all this mean...?"
Gabon: "Those people just now were the ≪Solitary Silver Wings≫."
Touya: "What's that?"
Gabon: "It's their name.
They're a small mercenary band, but probably one of the top one or two
on the continent in ability."
Clovis: "Huh, old man, you know that side of things?
You don't look like the type."
Ymir: "Gabon fought in the great war thirty-three years ago.
It was the last battle to engulf all of Agarthia,
or so I learned."
Gabon: "Well, more or less.
As for that mercenary band, I've never met them myself,
but ≪Venir≫ lost its commander and deputy five years ago.
I hear it's an empty shell now. That leaves only one group
that could own custom Armored Mechs..."
Derock: "That's the Solitary Silver Wings."
Gabon: "Don't steal my line!
Do you want another liposuction operation without anesthesia?"
Derock: "Eee! A-Anything but that!
P-Please forgive me! I-I was wrong.
L-Lady Celica, please save me..."
Celica: "Isn't this a good opportunity?
Why don't you let him?"
Derock: "That's so cruel...
Enjoying bullying me like that is downright nasty.
If you keep doing that... Mutter, mutter..."
Arthur: "Then you think those people
were the ≪Solitary Silver Wings≫?"
Gabon: "Y-Yeah.
They're infamous for taking any job from any country
if the money's right.
But their skill is the real thing. Especially their commander.
They say he could command a country's army corps."
Touya: "What's a group like that doing here?"
Arthur: "Their clean withdrawal suggests
it might have been a chance encounter, but we don't know."
Touya: "Then what about that black Armored Mech?
Its pilot seemed to know Celica."
Celica: "Yes... Well.
He came to study at the Agarthian Royal Academy five years ago,
and we studied together for two years.
Tix especially looked up to him. They were closer
than real brothers and always together.
Then, three years ago, he suddenly vanished..."
Touya: "And when he reappears, he's in an Armored Mech like that,
picking a fight with us..."
Celica: "Yes. But there's no point getting gloomy!
Besides, we don't know that Cain is an enemy yet!"
Ymir: "Anyway, let's look at the facility first..."
Ymir: "What?!"
Sisk: "Um... Oh! Th-The facility...
The facility has been blown up!"
Miyasco: "!?"
Clovis: "It vanished without a trace..."
Arthur: "Was it the work of those mercenaries?"
Celica: "..."
Touya: "What do we do now?"
Ymir: "We could stay in Zigrim to gather information,
but we don't know enough yet. Moving around
without a plan wouldn't be wise."
Arthur: "Indeed.
I'm concerned about the reading in the royal capital
His Highness mentioned, too...
Shall we go back to the capital?"
Aurelie: "That seems sensible."
Captain Roa: "Hmm."
Ymir: "Understood. I agree with the captain.
Baren, set course for Shangria, Agarthia's royal capital."
Baren: "Understood."
Celica: "Everyone! Good news!"
Touya: "Hmm? Did you get your hands on some rare parts?"
Celica: "Huh? Well, that would make me happy too...
But no! I've finally finished that device!"
Ymir: "That device...? Oh!"
Celica: "Heh heh heh! Yes!
The anti-field unit, 'Resonance Buddy No. 1,' is complete!
It should let us break through ≪Ze=Ode≫'s field!"
Touya: "Oh!"
Fain: "Princess! You're amazing!"
Celica: "Ahem! Though the analysis and logic
were Ymir's work.
Now we just need to check compatibility with the Spirit Mechs and make adjustments.
As for enhanced upgrades, thanks to Brother
pulling some strings,
we've received some pretty good materials.
They'll let us expand things a little more."
Touya: "...What does that mean?"
Yamato: "It means we can do more upgrades
than before, right?"
Celica: "Correct. In practice, we'll be able to upgrade
twice as much as before."
Touya: "Wow. That's something.
When can we start?"
Celica: "The materials are already delivered, so we can start right now.
We really have to thank Brother."
Touya: "Field countermeasures and upgrades... So now
we can fight ≪Ze=Ode≫...
All that's left is Rayblade."
Celica: "Rayblade's almost ready too.
So this is where things really begin."
Touya: "Yeah. The real battle starts now."
Maki: "Huff, huff... I-I managed to escape,
but... Where am I...?"
Reisuke: "Beep!"
Maki: "Huh? Oh! Th-This is... The dining room!
Lucky me!♥"
Reisuke: "Beep-beep-beep?"
Maki: "Oh, a refrigerator!
Now, I'll get something to eat... Let's see..."
Derock: "Hmm... It's all in here."
Maki: "Eek... Aaaaaaaaah!
Wh-Wh-Why are you inside the refrigerator?!"
Derock: "As you can see, I'm enjoying
a lovely meal... Hup!"
Derock: "Phew... It is a little cramped."
Maki: "...How did that huge body fit in there...?"
Derock: "Heh... More importantly, who are you?"
Maki: "Huh? Oh, ha ha... Um..."
Derock: "Hmm... I've seen that face somewhere before..."
Maki: "Well, then, I should take my leave..."
Derock: "Wait. I've remembered.
You're that journalist.
I've caught you. You can't escape now."
Maki: "Huh? No way! When did you...?!"
Derock: "I'm taking you in."
Ymir: "...I see. I understand your position.
You want to check whether we're really fighting ≪Ze=Ode≫,
and whether that's the purpose of our activities. Is that right?"
Maki: "And Rayblade. I've heard it caused the ≪Terror of Ze=Ode≫,
that it was the source of the disaster.
I want to get to the bottom of that."
Touya: "Hey, you're not going to allow it, are you?
She's suspicious of us from the start.
Won't she end up writing all sorts of things, true or not?"
Arthur: "Not necessarily.
We haven't done anything to be ashamed of.
It wouldn't hurt to let someone see
what can't be seen from outside."
Clovis: "Well, if we turn her away,
she'll obviously write all sorts of things about us."
Maki: "Well, there you have it..."
Fain: "Is it true you caught a stowaway...?
Whoa?! B-Big Sis Maki?!"
Maki: "Huh? Oh, Fain-chan!♪
Wow, look how you've grown... Still fired up?"
Touya: "What's with this 'fired up' thing...?"
Fain: "B-Big Sis Maki... Could you finally stop
calling me '-chan'...? Please?"
Maki: "Oh, right! I heard an Agarthian knight
had become a Spirit Mech pilot.
So it was Fain-chan!
Anyway, I'll be staying with you for a while.
Take care of me!♥"
Baio: "That stingy raccoon Growster! He only adopts Daga...
He balks when I put a mere twelve-billion-mil
price tag on it!
He doesn't understand that, considering its abilities,
it's a bargain! Don't you agree, Melissa?"
Melissa: "Yes, Doctor... But 'stingy raccoon' is a bit much."
Baio: "I don't care! Anyone who lumps my Bine Daga
in with mere Spirit Mechs
deserves to be called a stupid, stingy raccoon!"
Melissa: "Yes, Doctor. But 'stupid, stingy raccoon' is...
Baio: "What's wrong? Does your head hurt?"
Melissa: "...Spirit... Mechs... Ugh..."
Baio: "A-Are you all right?!
Y-You need to rest. Come on..."
Melissa: "Y-Yes... I'm sorry..."
Baio: "Don't worry. You've been testing Bine Daga
nonstop lately. It's no wonder.
Just take it easy today."
Melissa: "Yes..."
Baio: "Spirit Mechs... Why does that name...? Don't tell me..."
Doris: "Mm... Mmm..."
Dei: "Did I wake you?"
Doris: "...What's wrong?"
Dei: "Nothing."
Doris: "...Liar. It's about that person, isn't it?"
Dei: "Heh... Don't be ridiculous..."
Doris: "Then what is it?"
Dei: "It's about myself."
Doris: "..."
Dei: "...I thought so. You've noticed too...
Sometimes I feel like I become someone
other than myself...
That feeling has only grown since the meeting today."
Doris: "...You're yourself. No one else.
Don't forget. The woman who knows you best
is right here. Have confidence, Dei."
Dei: "Yes... I'm Dei Rakbal.
...I'm sorry."
Doris: "That's right. You must stay strong.
For the sake of our dearest wish..."
Dei: "Yes. You're right.
Doris... I'm counting on you for that matter."
Doris: "Yes. Leave it to me.
Someone interfered last time, but next time I'll definitely..."
Dei: "Heh heh. That's reassuring."
Doris: "...Hey."
Dei: "Hmm?"
Doris: "...Now I'm wide awake..."
